title: Flame Lotus Sorceress
description: A dark-skinned woman with glowing fiery patterns on her skin stands in a desert landscape. She wears an elaborate crown of red lotus flowers engulfed in flames and holds several small floating fiery blossoms in her outstretched hand.
prompt: A beautiful dark-skinned young woman with glowing orange vein-like patterns on her face and hands, wearing a dramatic flowing red and orange robe. Her head is crowned with a large blooming red lotus flower engulfed in realistic flames. She holds her hand out, releasing several small fiery lotus blossoms that float in the air. She stands in a surreal fiery desert at dusk with glowing orange rivers of lava and burning cacti in the background, dramatic cinematic lighting, painterly style
